summary: Gebru criticizes the race to build giant general-purpose AI models and calls for small, task-specific tools and accountability from their builders.

statements.quote: Before you put something out there, you should be able to tell us where all the data came from and actually document it.
The path we’re on right now was never a preordained path that we had to be on.
I’m in the field of AI, and in my field, I would describe it as corporate-driven and sloppy.
It’s just that people came along and decided that they want to build a machine god and then claimed that they are doing it.
